fit.estimator: contracts/observables.json: effective_translational_diffusivity -- weighted least squares of MSD on lag over lags at or above the declared lower bound, slope over 2*d, weights sqrt of independent displacements per lag

uncertainty.note: block-resampled over particles, the honest error bar; single-particle blocks when the arm holds fewer particles than blocks

persistence_time.estimator: contracts/observables.json: persistence_time -- exponential fit to the orientational autocorrelation over the declared lag window
